details.s: Éomer Éadig was a man of Rohan and the eventual eighteenth King of Rohan, and first of the Third Line of their Kings. In the last decade of the Third Age, Éomer was the Third Marshal of the Mark.
f: Third Marshal of the Riddermark, Lord of the Mark, King of Rohan
